news.titleEn: Lula wins fourth term as Brazil's president, beating Flávio Bolsonaro in runoff
news.conclusionEn: Lula came from behind to beat Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil's Oct. 25 runoff, winning a fourth term, and offshore Brazilian assets sold off sharply on the surprise.
news.conclusionZh: 卢拉逆转击败小博索纳罗，赢得第四个总统任期
news.whyEn: Markets had priced in a Bolsonaro win; investors now fear looser spending and rising debt in Latin America's largest economy.
news.whyZh: 市场原本押注博索纳罗获胜，如今担忧巴西财政扩张、债务攀升
news.detailEn: Lula, who trailed Bolsonaro 45% to 47% in the first round, won the runoff roughly 52% to 48%. He campaigned on debt relief for small businesses, free weekend public transport and ending the six-day workweek. On Sunday evening, CME dollar futures jumped about 10% against the real and a Tokyo-listed Ibovespa ETF fell more than 11% at Monday's open. Thin weekend trading can overshoot, so the real test comes when Brazilian markets open Monday.
news.detailZh: 首轮卢拉以45%比47%落后，决选以约52%比48%反超获胜。他的竞选承诺包括小企业债务减免、周末公共交通免费以及废除六天工作制。周日晚间CME美元兑雷亚尔期货跳涨约10%，东京上市的巴西股指ETF周一开盘暴跌逾11%。周末交易清淡、容易过度反应，周一巴西本土开盘才是真正的检验。

news.titleEn: Asian shares make cautious start, Brent eases from six-month high
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude slipped about 1% to around $115 in early Asian trade Monday after jumping 6.2% last week, as Qatari mediators reportedly visited Tehran to cool regional tensions.
news.conclusionZh: 布油周一回落1%至约115美元，上周大涨6.2%
news.whyEn: Oil above $100 feeds inflation worldwide and is pushing markets to price a Fed rate hike in December.
news.whyZh: 油价破百推高全球通胀，市场已押注美联储12月加息
news.detailEn: Brent hit its highest weekly close since mid-2022 last week as Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked supply fears; WTI traded around $102. Reports that Qatar, coordinating with the U.S., sent mediators to Tehran offered some hope of de-escalation. Asian stocks opened cautiously, with Japan's Nikkei down about 0.8%. Markets see an 80% chance the Fed hikes in December even as G3 central banks are expected to hold this week.
news.detailZh: 受胡塞武装袭击沙特引发的供应担忧推动，布伦特原油上周创下2022年中以来最高周收盘价，WTI约在102美元。据报道卡塔尔在美国协调下派调解人赴德黑兰，带来一丝降温希望。亚洲股市谨慎开盘，日经指数跌约0.8%。尽管美欧日央行本周预计按兵不动，市场认为美联储12月加息概率达80%。

news.titleEn: Stock futures climb as traders try to recover from the S&P 500's losing week: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stock futures rose Sunday night ahead of a packed week featuring Fed, ECB and Bank of Japan rate decisions plus earnings from Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Apple.
news.conclusionZh: 美股期货反弹，本周迎来央行决议与科技巨头财报
news.whyEn: Three major central banks and the biggest AI spenders report in the same week, likely setting market direction into year-end.
news.whyZh: 三大央行决议与AI巨头财报同周登场，或决定年底市场走向
news.detailEn: The Fed announces its decision Wednesday, the ECB on Thursday and the BOJ on Friday. Microsoft and Alphabet report Wednesday after the close, just hours after the Fed, with Amazon and Apple following Thursday. After Meta's stock slumped on heavy AI spending last week, investors will focus on cloud growth, AI monetization and capex guidance. The S&P 500 is coming off a losing week, so the results could decide whether the AI trade steadies or deepens its pullback.
news.detailZh: 美联储周三公布决议，欧洲央行周四、日本央行周五跟进。微软和谷歌母公司Alphabet周三盘后发布财报，紧随美联储决议之后，亚马逊和苹果周四公布。上周Meta因AI支出过高股价重挫，投资者将重点关注云业务增长、AI变现和资本开支指引。标普500上周收跌，本周财报将决定AI行情是企稳还是继续回调。

news.titleEn: Roundup: Riyadh airport partially reopens as Houthis, Saudi-led coalition continue exchanging attacks
news.conclusionEn: Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport partially reopened after a two-week closure, even as the Houthis fired new waves of missiles at Saudi Arabia and called the airport a military target.
news.conclusionZh: 利雅得机场部分恢复运营，胡塞武装继续导弹袭击沙特
news.whyEn: Attacks on the world's top oil exporter are the main driver of this month's oil price spike.
news.whyZh: 全球最大石油出口国遭袭，是本月油价飙升的主要推手
news.detailEn: The Houthis said they launched dozens of ballistic missiles in three attacks, the first aimed at the Riyadh airport, in retaliation for Saudi strikes on Sanaa. The coalition said it intercepted 12 missiles and two drones, with debris injuring two people in Khamis Mushait. A Houthi spokesman warned airlines to avoid Saudi airspace except over Mecca and Medina. The Dakar Rally has already moved its 2027 race out of Saudi Arabia over security concerns.
news.detailZh: 胡塞武装称分三波发射数十枚弹道导弹，首波瞄准利雅得机场，以报复沙特对萨那的空袭。联军称拦截12枚导弹和2架无人机，碎片在海米斯穆谢特致2人受伤。胡塞发言人警告航空公司避开除麦加、麦地那以外的沙特领空。达喀尔拉力赛已因安全原因将2027年赛事迁出沙特。

news.titleEn: Thousands of Israelis rally against Netanyahu gov't days before election
news.conclusionEn: Thousands rallied in Tel Aviv against Netanyahu's government ahead of Tuesday's (Oct. 27) general election, where polls show his bloc neck and neck with challenger Gadi Eisenkot's.
news.conclusionZh: 以色列周二大选前夕，数千人集会反对内塔尼亚胡
news.whyEn: The result could change Israel's stance on Iran and Gaza, a key factor for Middle East risk and oil prices.
news.whyZh: 选举结果或改变以色列对伊朗和加沙的立场，牵动中东风险与油价
news.detailEn: Protesters in Hostages Square demanded a state commission of inquiry into the security failures before the Oct. 7, 2023 attack. Opposition figures including Eisenkot and Yair Golan attended; neither bloc is currently projected to reach a 61-seat majority. Eisenkot is seen as less inclined than Netanyahu to resume military action against Iran. A hung result could mean weeks of coalition bargaining.
news.detailZh: 抗议者在「人质广场」要求成立国家调查委员会，追查2023年10月7日袭击前的安全失误。艾森科特、亚伊尔·戈兰等反对派人物到场；目前两大阵营均未达到61席多数。外界认为艾森科特比内塔尼亚胡更不倾向于重启对伊朗的军事行动。若无阵营过半，组阁谈判或持续数周。

news.titleEn: Vucic Concedes Defeat In Pivotal Serbian Parliamentary Election
news.conclusionEn: Aleksandar Vucic conceded defeat as the student-led Students' List won Serbia's snap parliamentary election, ending more than 14 years of his dominance.
news.conclusionZh: 学生名单赢得塞尔维亚大选，武契奇承认败选
news.whyEn: A rare peaceful transfer of power driven by an anti-corruption movement reshapes the Balkans and Serbia's EU path.
news.whyZh: 反腐运动推动政权和平更替，将重塑巴尔干格局与塞尔维亚入欧前景
news.detailEn: The Students' List was projected to win about 135-140 seats versus about 105 for Vucic's party, on the highest turnout in decades. The movement grew out of nearly two years of protests after the deadly Novi Sad railway canopy collapse in November 2024. Its leader Ilija Srdanovic pledged to build a state governed by the rule of law. Investors will watch how the new government handles EU accession talks and relations with Russia and China.
news.detailZh: 学生名单预计获得约135-140席，武契奇所在政党约105席，投票率创数十年新高。该运动源于2024年11月诺维萨德火车站雨棚坍塌致命事故后近两年的抗议。领导人伊利亚·斯尔达诺维奇承诺建设法治国家。投资者将关注新政府如何推进入欧谈判，以及处理与俄罗斯和中国的关系。

news.titleEn: More than 1,000 arrested in France as protesters and police clash in several cities
news.conclusionEn: More than 1,300 people were arrested as about 410,000 joined cost-of-living protests across France, with unrest also spreading to Italy, Spain, Albania and Portugal.
news.conclusionZh: 法国生活成本抗议逾千人被捕，多国爆发示威
news.whyEn: Spreading anger over living costs, fuelled by high energy prices, raises political risk across Europe.
news.whyZh: 高能源价格引发的生活成本怒火蔓延，欧洲政治风险上升
news.detailEn: France's Interior Ministry counted 410,000 protesters across 298 demonstrations, while unions claimed 800,000; 53 police were injured. Authorities deployed 70,000 officers with armored vehicles and water cannons. Italy sent soldiers to Milan after looting, and Spain saw large marches in defense of pensions. The Yellow Vests have called for another round of protests on Oct. 31.
news.detailZh: 法国内政部统计298场示威共41万人参加，工会则称达80万；53名警察受伤。当局部署7万名警力，配备装甲车和水炮。意大利因抢劫事件向米兰派驻士兵，西班牙爆发大规模捍卫养老金游行。「黄背心」已呼吁10月31日再度上街。

news.titleEn: Western Sydney airport is open from today. Here’s everything you need to know
news.conclusionEn: Sydney's A$5.3bn second airport, Western Sydney International, opened to passengers on Sunday, operating 24 hours a day.
news.conclusionZh: 耗资53亿澳元的西悉尼国际机场周日正式通航
news.whyEn: Sydney's first new airport in a century adds curfew-free capacity, reshaping airline competition and western Sydney's economy.
news.whyZh: 悉尼百年来首座新机场，无宵禁运力将改变航空竞争和西悉尼经济
news.detailEn: Located about 60km from the CBD, the airport opened with Jetstar flights to Melbourne, the Gold Coast and Brisbane. Air New Zealand starts Auckland flights from Oct. 26 and Singapore Airlines plans daily Singapore service from Nov. 23, while Qantas joins in March 2027. Unlike Kingsford Smith, it has no night curfew, giving airlines and freight operators more flexibility.
news.detailZh: 机场距悉尼市中心约60公里，开航首日由捷星执飞墨尔本、黄金海岸和布里斯班航线。新西兰航空10月26日起开通奥克兰航线，新加坡航空计划11月23日起每日飞新加坡，澳航将于2027年3月入驻。与金斯福德·史密斯机场不同，它没有夜间宵禁，为航司和货运提供更大灵活性。

news.titleEn: Presidential race in Bulgaria heads to runoff due to record low turnout
news.conclusionEn: Bulgaria's presidential election ended inconclusively, with incumbent Iliana Iotova set to face former prime minister Andrey Gyurov in a runoff after record-low turnout.
news.conclusionZh: 保加利亚总统选举投票率创新低，将进入第二轮
news.whyEn: Voter apathy in an EU and NATO frontline state on the Black Sea underscores Europe's wider political fatigue.
news.whyZh: 黑海前线的欧盟与北约成员国选民冷漠，折射欧洲政治疲态
news.detailEn: Iotova finished first but no candidate secured the majority needed, and turnout was the lowest on record. The vote came in the wake of deadly drone strikes in the Black Sea region. The runoff will decide who holds a largely ceremonial but influential post in a country that has cycled through repeated snap elections.
news.detailZh: 约托娃首轮领先，但无人获得所需多数，投票率创历史新低。此次选举正值黑海地区发生致命无人机袭击之后。第二轮将决定这一职权以礼仪为主、但颇具影响力的职位归属，保加利亚近年已多次举行提前选举。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is the tendency to keep investing in a project because of what you've already spent, rather than what it will return from here. Money, time and effort already spent can't be recovered, so they shouldn't drive the next decision. Good managers ask only: given where we are today, is the next dollar worth it?
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误是指因为「已经投入太多」而继续投入，而不是看未来能带来什么回报。已花掉的钱、时间和精力无法收回，不应左右下一步决策。好的管理者只问一个问题：站在今天的位置，下一块钱值得投吗？
businessTips.exampleEn: A company has spent $2 million on software that still doesn't work and needs $1 million more. If an off-the-shelf tool costs $300,000 and does the job, the right move is to switch, no matter how painful the $2 million feels.
businessTips.exampleZh: 某公司已花200万美元开发一套仍不好用的软件，还需再投100万。若现成工具只要30万且能满足需求，正确做法就是换掉，无论那200万多么让人心痛。

businessTips.explanationEn: Pre-selling means taking orders or deposits for a product before it exists. It is the strongest form of validation, because people paying is far more reliable than people saying they'd buy. It also funds the first production run and reduces inventory risk.
businessTips.explanationZh: 预售是指在产品做出来之前就收订单或定金。这是最有力的需求验证，因为「掏钱」远比「说会买」可靠。它还能为首批生产提供资金，降低库存风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before recording a cooking course, a creator offers 50 early-bird spots at half price. If 40 sell in a week, they build it; if only 3 sell, they refund buyers and have saved months of work.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位博主在录制烹饪课前，先以半价开放50个早鸟名额。如果一周卖出40个就开工制作；若只卖出3个，就退款，省下了几个月的工夫。

businessTips.explanationEn: Country risk premium is the extra return investors demand to hold assets in a country because of political, fiscal or currency risks. When it rises, the local currency usually weakens, bond yields climb and stock valuations fall. Elections and budget policy are common triggers.
businessTips.explanationZh: 国家风险溢价是投资者因一国政治、财政或汇率风险而要求的额外回报。溢价上升时，本币通常走弱、国债收益率上升、股票估值下降。选举和财政政策是常见的触发因素。
businessTips.exampleEn: After Lula's surprise win, offshore traders sold the Brazilian real and a Tokyo-listed Brazil ETF on fears of looser spending, a live example of a country risk premium being repriced overnight.
businessTips.exampleZh: 卢拉意外胜选后，海外交易员因担心财政扩张而抛售巴西雷亚尔和东京上市的巴西ETF，这正是国家风险溢价一夜之间被重新定价的现实案例。
